\[
A_{k+1} = A'_k \setminus D_2(A'_k),\quad A'_k = A_k \setminus D_1(A_k)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(A_k\): The foreground after k iterations
- \(D_1, D_2\): The pixels the two sub-iterations remove

D_1 and D_2 are the pixels that the first and the second sub-iteration may remove. Each is decided from the 8 neighbors of a pixel, so that removing it keeps shapes connected and line ends in place. All pixels marked in one sub-iteration go at once. Zhang-Suen follows the rules of the 1984 paper. The zhang method of skimage.morphology.skeletonize uses a modified table and gives other results. Guo-Hall follows the tables of skimage.morphology.thin and matches it.
